repos.description: Your own personal AI assistant. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw 是一款个人 AI 助手，支持在 WhatsApp、Telegram、Slack 等主流通讯平台运行，兼容 macOS/iOS/Android 系统，具备语音交互与实时画布渲染能力。其网关为控制平面，核心产品是本地部署的个性化助手，强调隐私、速度与持续在线体验。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant that runs on your own devices across any OS and platform. It integrates with messaging apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, and Slack, supports voice interaction, live canvas rendering, and prioritizes local deployment for privacy, speed, and always-on personal assistance.

repos.description: f.k.a. Awesome ChatGPT Prompts. Share, discover, and collect prompts from the community. Free and open source — self-host for your organization with complete privacy.
repos.summary_zh: prompts.chat 是全球最大的开源提示词库，涵盖 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等主流 AI 模型。提供社区驱动的提示词分享与收集平台，支持免费使用及私有化部署，兼具学术引用价值与工业级实用性。
repos.summary_en: Prompts.chat is the world's largest open-source prompt library for AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. It offers a community-driven platform to share, discover, and collect prompts, with free public access and self-hosting options for organizations seeking privacy.

repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more. Only official website: ccswitch.io
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台桌面一体化助手工具，支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 的统一管理，提供便捷的 AI 编程助手集成与配置，适用于多模型协作开发场景。
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform desktop all-in-one assistant tool for managing Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, enabling unified configuration and integration of multiple AI coding assistants for streamlined development workflows.

repos.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了30,000+行关于主流AI编程工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Devin AI等）的系统提示、内部工具和模型架构的深度解析，涵盖其设计理念、功能实现与技术细节，为开发者提供全面的AI编程助手技术洞察与最佳实践参考。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains over 30,000 lines of insights into system prompts, internal tools, and AI models of major AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Devin AI), offering deep technical analysis of their architecture, functionality, and design principles for developers seeking to understand and leverage AI-powered development tools.

repos.description: 🔥 The Web Data API for AI - Turn entire websites into LLM-ready markdown or structured data
repos.summary_zh: Firecrawl 是一个专为 AI 设计的网页数据 API，可将任意网站转换为 LLM 可直接使用的结构化数据（如 Markdown、JSON、截图等），支持 JavaScript 渲染、动态内容抓取、批量处理和内容变更监控，显著提升 AI 应用的数据获取效率与准确性。
repos.summary_en: Firecrawl is a web data API designed for AI, converting any website into LLM-ready structured data (e.g., Markdown, JSON, screenshots). It supports JavaScript rendering, dynamic content extraction, batch processing, and change tracking, significantly enhancing data acquisition for AI applications.

repos.description: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.
repos.summary_zh: NextChat 是一款轻量级、高性能的 AI 助手应用，支持 Web、iOS、macOS、Android、Linux 和 Windows 全平台。它集成了 Claude、DeepSeek、GPT-4 和 Gemini Pro 等多种 AI 模型，提供现代化的用户界面和强大的功能，包括 MCP 支持、企业级私有化部署、知识库集成和权限管理，适用于个人用户和企业客户。
repos.summary_en: NextChat is a lightweight and fast AI assistant supporting Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, and Windows. It integrates multiple AI models including Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, and Gemini Pro. Featuring modern UI, MCP support, enterprise-grade private deployment, knowledge base integration, and admin panel with permission controls.

repos.description: 🌐 Make websites accessible for AI agents. Automate tasks online with ease.
repos.summary_zh: Browser-Use 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的网页自动化框架，通过 LLM 驱动浏览器完成复杂在线任务。支持主流大模型（Gemini、Claude 等），提供 stealth 模式云浏览器服务，实现高效、隐蔽的网页交互与数据采集，适用于自动化测试、信息抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Browser-Use is an AI agent framework that enables LLM-driven automation of web tasks. It supports major LLMs (Gemini, Claude, etc.) and offers stealth cloud browsers for secure, scalable automation. Ideal for web scraping, testing, and data collection with seamless integration.

repos.description: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs
repos.summary_zh: RAGFlow 是一款领先的开放源代码检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，深度融合 RAG 与 Agent 能力，为大型语言模型构建卓越的上下文层。它提供简洁高效的 RAG 工作流，适用于各类规模企业，支持多语言文档处理、智能问答、知识库构建及 Agent 驱动任务自动化。
repos.summary_en: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that seamlessly integrates advanced RAG with Agent capabilities to build superior context layers for LLMs. It delivers a streamlined, scalable workflow ideal for enterprises, supporting multilingual document processing, intelligent Q&A, knowledge base construction, and agent-driven task automation.

repos.description: ChatGPT 中文调教指南。各种场景使用指南。学习怎么让它听你的话。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供全面的 ChatGPT 中文调教指南，涵盖学术论文、创意写作、商业文案、翻译、数据分析等 20+ 应用场景，帮助用户掌握提示词技巧，让 AI 高效完成各类任务，提升工作效率与内容质量。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive guide to prompting ChatGPT in Chinese, covering over 20 use cases including academic writing, creative content, business communication, translation, and data analysis. It empowers users to master prompt engineering and leverage AI for enhanced productivity and content quality.

repos.description: Build AI Agents, Visually
repos.summary_zh: Flowise 是一个可视化 AI 智能体构建平台，支持通过拖拽方式快速搭建 LLM 应用流程。它提供图形化界面集成主流大模型、向量数据库和工具节点，支持本地部署与云端服务，适用于开发者和企业快速原型开发与生产部署。
repos.summary_en: Flowise is a visual platform for building AI agents and LLM applications using drag-and-drop workflows. It integrates major LLMs, vector databases, and tools via a no-code interface, supporting both self-hosted and cloud deployment for rapid prototyping and production use.

repos.description: 👩🏿‍💻👨🏾‍💻👩🏼‍💻👨🏽‍💻👩🏻‍💻中国独立开发者项目列表 -- 分享大家都在做什么
repos.summary_zh: 中国独立开发者项目列表聚合了2026年2月最新上线的创新产品，涵盖AI语音助手、投资理财工具、打字练习平台、音乐生成、简历优化、浏览器插件等多个领域。项目以网站或App形式呈现，强调实用性与用户体验，如智能语音朗读、美股A股基金定投计算、AI音乐创作等，展现了中国独立开发者在AI应用与垂直场景工具上的活跃创新。
repos.summary_en: This repo aggregates innovative projects by Chinese indie developers launched in February 2026, including AI voice assistants, investment calculators, typing trainers, music generation tools, resume optimizers, and browser extensions. All projects are web or app-based, emphasizing practicality and user experience, such as intelligent text-to-speech, stock/fund investment analysis, AI-powered songwriting, and productivity tools, showcasing active innovation in AI applications and niche utility apps.

repos.summary_zh: WeChatMsg 是一个微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，支持将聊天记录导出为多种格式（如 Excel、HTML），并提供可视化分析功能。项目强调个人数据主权，倡导用户自主管理生活痕迹，未来计划结合 AI 技术构建个人记忆数据中心，实现智能相册与年度报告生成。
repos.summary_en: WeChatMsg is a WeChat chat export and analysis tool that supports exporting chats to formats like Excel and HTML with visualization features. It emphasizes personal data ownership, enabling users to manage their digital footprints. The project aims to integrate AI for building personal memory data centers, including smart photo albums and annual report generation.

repos.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提升 AI 提示词质量的优化工具，支持多轮迭代优化、双模式提示词处理、实时对比测试及多模型集成（OpenAI/Gemini/DeepSeek等），同时提供文生图、图生图、MCP协议支持等高级功能，适用于角色扮演、知识图谱提取、创意写作等场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is an AI prompt optimization tool designed to enhance prompt quality through intelligent refinement, multi-round iteration, and dual-mode optimization. It supports real-time comparison, integration with major AI models (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek), advanced features like text-to-image generation, MCP protocol compatibility, and secure client-side processing for reliable and efficient prompt engineering.

repos.description: Powerful AI Client
repos.summary_zh: Chatbox 是一款跨平台桌面 AI 客户端，支持 ChatGPT、Claude 等主流大模型，提供多端同步、插件扩展、提示工程优化等功能，适用于开发者、研究人员和AI爱好者的高效生产力工具。
repos.summary_en: Chatbox is a powerful cross-platform desktop AI client supporting ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs. It offers multi-device sync, plugin support, prompt engineering, and advanced customization for developers and AI enthusiasts.

repos.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: AI网站克隆模板，通过AI编程代理一键逆向工程任意网站为现代化Next.js代码库。支持Claude Code等主流AI工具，自动提取设计元素、生成组件规范并并行构建页面结构，显著提升前端开发效率。
repos.summary_en: AI Website Cloner Template enables one-command reverse-engineering of any website into a modern Next.js codebase using AI coding agents. It automatically extracts design tokens, generates component specifications, and reconstructs pages through parallel builders, supporting major platforms like Claude Code for rapid frontend development.

repos.description: Vane is an AI-powered answering engine.
repos.summary_zh: Vane 是一个隐私优先的 AI 问答引擎，支持本地 LLM（Ollama）和云端大模型（OpenAI、Claude、Groq），结合互联网知识库与 SearxNG 网页搜索，提供带引用来源的精准回答。支持文件上传、多模态搜索、智能建议及本地历史记录，所有数据在本地处理以保障隐私。
repos.summary_en: Vane is a privacy-focused AI answering engine that runs on your hardware, combining internet knowledge with local LLMs (Ollama) and cloud providers (OpenAI, Claude, Groq). It delivers cited answers via SearxNG-powered web search, supports file uploads, multimodal content, smart suggestions, and maintains local search history—all while keeping data private.

repos.description: Your AI second brain. Self-hostable. Get answers from the web or your docs. Build custom agents, schedule automations, do deep research. Turn any online or local LLM into your personal, autonomous AI (gpt, claude, gemini, llama, qwen, mistral). Get started - free.
repos.summary_zh: Khoj 是一款自托管的个人 AI 应用，可作为你的 AI 第二大脑。它支持与本地或在线 LLM（如 Llama3、GPT、Claude、Gemini 等）对话，从互联网或文档中获取答案，并构建自定义智能体、自动化任务及深度研究。具备语义搜索、多格式文档解析、跨平台访问等功能，完全开源且隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Khoj is a self-hostable personal AI app acting as your AI second brain. It enables interaction with any local or online LLM (e.g., Llama3, GPT, Claude), retrieves answers from the web or your documents, builds custom agents, automates research, and supports semantic search across PDFs, Markdown, Notion, Word files, and more. Fully open-source and privacy-focused.

repos.description: Langchain-Chatchat（原Langchain-ChatGLM）基于 Langchain 与 ChatGLM, Qwen 与 Llama 等语言模型的 RAG 与 Agent 应用 | Langchain-Chatchat (formerly langchain-ChatGLM), local knowledge based LLM (like ChatGLM, Qwen and Llama) RAG and Agent app with langchain
repos.summary_zh: Langchain-Chatchat 是基于 Langchain 框架的开源本地知识库问答系统，支持 ChatGLM、Qwen、Llama 等主流开源大模型，提供 RAG（检索增强生成）与 Agent 应用能力。项目支持离线部署，兼容多种向量数据库与 Embedding 模型，具备 FastAPI 接口与 Streamlit WebUI，适用于私有化部署的文档问答与智能助手场景。
repos.summary_en: Langchain-Chatchat is an open-source local knowledge base QA system built on the Langchain framework, supporting mainstream open-source LLMs like ChatGLM, Qwen, and Llama. It provides RAG and Agent capabilities with offline deployment, compatibility for various vector databases and embedding models, and offers both FastAPI endpoints and a Streamlit WebUI for document-based Q&A and intelligent assistant applications.

repos.description: OpenAssistant is a chat-based assistant that understands tasks, can interact with third-party systems, and retrieve information dynamically to do so.
repos.summary_zh: Open Assistant 是一个开源的聊天式AI助手项目，旨在提供可交互、可集成第三方系统的语言模型服务。项目已完成，核心贡献是构建并发布了 oasst2 高质量对话数据集，推动开放语言模型发展。
repos.summary_en: Open Assistant was an open-source chat-based AI assistant project designed to provide accessible, interactive large language model capabilities with third-party system integration. The project is now completed, with its final oasst2 dataset published on HuggingFace, marking a significant contribution to open-source language model training data.

repos.description: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!
repos.summary_zh: AionUi 是一款免费、开源的 AI 协作者应用，支持 24/7 自动化，内置多 AI 智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Qwen Code 等），提供跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）本地运行、零配置启动、远程访问（WebUI/Telegram/Lark）和任务调度功能，适用于代码开发、文件处理与自动化工作流。
repos.summary_en: AionUi is a free, open-source AI coworking app that enables 24/7 automation with built-in multi-agent support (e.g., Claude Code, OpenClaw, Qwen Code). It offers zero-setup local execution, cross-platform compatibility, remote access via WebUI/Telegram, and scheduled task automation for coding, file operations, and workflow management.

repos.description: "🐈 nanobot: The Ultra-Lightweight OpenClaw"
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是一个超轻量级个人 AI 助手，灵感来自 OpenClaw，核心功能仅约 4,000 行代码，比 Clawdbot 缩小 99%。支持多平台通信（Slack、Discord、Feishu、DingTalk 等）、MCP 协议、多模态文件处理及智能会话管理，具备高可靠性与模块化扩展能力，适用于个人自动化与智能交互场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an ultra-lightweight personal AI assistant inspired by OpenClaw, delivering core agent functionality in just ~4,000 lines of code—99% smaller than Clawdbot. It supports multi-platform messaging (Slack, Discord, Feishu, etc.), MCP protocol, multimodal file handling, and robust session management, offering high reliability and modular extensibility for personal automation and intelligent interaction.

repos.description: An MCP-based chatbot | 一个基于MCP的聊天机器人
repos.summary_zh: 小智AI聊天机器人基于MCP协议实现多终端控制，集成Qwen/DeepSeek等大模型能力，支持流式ASR+LLM+TTS语音交互架构。具备离线语音唤醒、3D声纹识别、OLED显示及ESP32系列芯片全平台适配，提供设备端与云端双模MCP扩展智能家居与PC操作功能。
repos.summary_en: XiaoZhi AI chatbot leverages MCP protocol for multi-terminal control with Qwen/DeepSeek large models, featuring streaming ASR+LLM+TTS voice interaction, offline wake-up, 3D speaker recognition, and OLED display. Supports ESP32 series chips with dual-mode device/cloud MCP for smart home and PC automation.

repos.description: A complete and graceful API for Wechat. 微信个人号接口、微信机器人及命令行微信，三十行即可自定义个人号机器人。
repos.summary_zh: itchat 是一个基于 Python 的微信个人号完整 API，支持微信机器人开发、命令行微信及自动化操作。通过简单代码即可实现消息收发、好友管理、附件下载、群聊处理等功能，支持多开、热重载、命令行二维码显示等高级特性，适合快速构建个性化微信应用。
repos.summary_en: itchat is a complete and elegant Python API for WeChat personal accounts, enabling easy development of WeChat bots, command-line WeChat, and automation. It supports message handling, friend management, file downloads, group chat processing, multi-instance operation, hot reload, and command-line QR code display, ideal for building custom WeChat applications quickly.

repos.description: Distilly — Distill how they think into reusable Skills for any Agent or Bot. Formerly Colleague Skill（原同事 Skill）.

repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Conversational RPA SDK for Chatbot Makers. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/7q8NBZbQzt
repos.summary_zh: Wechaty 是一个对话式 RPA SDK，专为聊天机器人开发者设计，提供跨 WhatsApp、微信等主流消息平台的统一接口，支持 TypeScript、Python、Go 等多语言开发，实现一次编写多平台运行，显著降低聊天机器人开发复杂度。
repos.summary_en: Wechaty is a conversational RPA SDK that simplifies chatbot development by offering a universal interface across messaging platforms like WhatsApp and WeChat. It supports multiple languages including TypeScript and Python, enabling developers to write once and deploy anywhere, streamlining bot creation with open-source ease and community support.

repos.description: 🤖 可 DIY 的 多模态 AI 聊天机器人 | 🚀 快速接入 微信、 QQ、Telegram、等聊天平台 | 🦈支持DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI | 工作流系统、网页搜索、AI画图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话 |
repos.summary_zh: Kirara AI 是一款可自定义的多模态 AI 聊天机器人，支持快速接入微信、QQ、Telegram 等主流聊天平台，兼容 DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI 等主流大模型。具备工作流系统、网页搜索、AI 绘图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话等功能，提供 WebUI 和 Docker 部署方案。
repos.summary_en: Kirara AI is a customizable multimodal AI chatbot that supports rapid integration with WeChat, QQ, Telegram, and other major messaging platforms. It integrates with leading LLMs including DeepSeek, Grok, Claude, Ollama, Gemini, and OpenAI. Features include workflow systems, web search, AI image generation, persona tuning, virtual maid mode, voice interaction, and offers both WebUI and Docker deployment options.

repos.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Playwright 和 AI 的闲鱼多任务实时监控工具，支持自然语言创建任务、多模态商品分析、定时调度与智能筛选。提供完整 Web 管理界面，集成 ntfy.sh/Bark/Telegram 通知，支持 Docker 一键部署与账号代理轮换，帮助用户高效发现目标商品。
repos.summary_en: AI-powered Xianyu monitoring system using Playwright for real-time/periodic multi-task tracking and analysis. Features natural language task creation, multimodal product analysis, cron scheduling, advanced filters (region/price/new-post), and full web UI with notifications via ntfy.sh/Bark/Telegram. Supports Docker deployment, account rotation, and proxy management.

repos.description: GUI for ChatGPT API and many LLMs. Supports agents, file-based QA, GPT finetuning and query with web search. All with a neat UI.
repos.summary_zh: 川虎 Chat 是一款为 ChatGPT 等多种大语言模型设计的轻量级 Web GUI，支持多模态 API、本地部署模型及 Agent 助理。提供文件问答、微调训练、联网搜索等功能，配备现代化毛玻璃 UI 和移动端适配，并支持历史记录管理与 PWA 安装。
repos.summary_en: Chuanhu Chat is a lightweight web GUI for ChatGPT and other LLMs, supporting multiple APIs, local models, agents, file-based QA, fine-tuning, and web search. Features a modern UI with glassmorphism, mobile support, history management, and PWA installation.

repos.description: LLM-powered framework for deep document understanding, semantic retrieval, and context-aware answers using RAG paradigm.
repos.summary_zh: WeKnora 是腾讯开源的 LLM 驱动文档理解与检索框架，基于 RAG 范式实现深度语义检索与上下文感知回答。支持多模态预处理、向量索引、智能检索及自定义 Agent，提供知识库管理、API 认证、K8s 部署等能力，适用于复杂异构文档的智能问答场景。
repos.summary_en: WeKnora is an LLM-powered framework for deep document understanding and semantic retrieval using the RAG paradigm. It features modular architecture with multimodal preprocessing, vector indexing, intelligent retrieval, and custom agents. Supports knowledge base management, API authentication, K8s deployment, and advanced features like thinking mode and data analysis.

repos.description: Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
repos.summary_zh: NoteGen是一款跨平台Markdown AI笔记软件，专注于通过AI将碎片化信息转化为结构化知识。核心功能包括智能语音转写、RAG知识库构建、MCP工具集成及自动化智能体处理，支持全平台同步且完全免费无广告，适用于高效记录与深度写作场景。
repos.summary_en: NoteGen is a cross-platform Markdown note-taking app that leverages AI to transform fragmented knowledge into structured notes. Key features include voice-to-text transcription, RAG-powered knowledge management, MCP tool integration, and automated AI agents. It offers free sync across all platforms with no ads, ideal for efficient recording and deep writing workflows.

repos.description: ✍ WeChat Markdown Editor | 一款高度简洁的微信 Markdown 编辑器：支持 Markdown 语法、自定义主题样式、内容管理、多图床、AI 助手等特性
repos.summary_zh: Doocs MD 是一款专为微信设计的简洁 Markdown 编辑器，支持完整 Markdown 语法、数学公式、Mermaid 图表、PlantUML 和 Ruby 注音，集成多图床上传与主流 AI 助手，提供自定义主题与本地草稿管理，实现 Markdown 内容一键渲染为美观微信图文。
repos.summary_en: Doocs MD is a minimalist Markdown editor tailored for WeChat, supporting full Markdown syntax, math formulas, Mermaid charts, PlantUML, Ruby annotations, multi-image hosting, and AI assistants. repos.summary_en: DeepChat is a powerful open-source AI agent platform that unifies models, tools, and agents, offering multi-LLM chat, MCP tool calling, and ACP agent integration for seamless desktop AI assistance.

repos.description: 【🔞🔞🔞 内含不适合未成年人阅读的图片】基于我擅长的编程、绘画、写作展开的 AI 探索和总结：StableDiffusion 是一种强大的图像生成模型，能够通过对一张图片进行演化来生成新的图片。ChatGPT 是一个基于 Transformer 的语言生成模型，它能够自动为输入的主题生成合适的文章。而 Github Copilot 是一个智能编程助手，能够加速日常编程活动。

repos.summary_en: This project explores AI applications in programming, painting, and writing through StableDiffusion image generation, ChatGPT text creation, and GitHub Copilot code assistance. It systematically analyzes how AI models interact with human input via prompt engineering for image description, article structuring, and code generation, proposing the concept of 'prompt programming' as a bridge between natural language and software development.

repos.summary_zh: Agently 4 是一个生产级 GenAI 应用开发框架，支持结构化数据交互、链式调用语法和事件驱动流（TriggerFlow）编排复杂工作逻辑。它提供契约优先的输出控制、多模型无缝切换能力，并集成会话管理、工具调用与 FastAPI，显著提升 AI 应用的开发效率与稳定性。
repos.summary_en: Agently 4 is a production-grade GenAI application development framework enabling structured data interaction, chained-calls syntax, and event-driven flow orchestration via TriggerFlow. It offers contract-first output control, seamless model switching, session management, tool integration, and FastAPI support to accelerate reliable AI app development.

repos.description: AI 写作伙伴，点亮你的创作灵感
repos.summary_zh: Arboris-Novel 是一款面向创作者的 AI 写作辅助工具，通过角色管理、大纲生成和智能续写功能帮助解决创作卡顿问题。支持多版本内容对比与个性化风格适配，旨在打造能理解角色、记忆世界设定的智能写作伙伴，提供 Docker 快速部署方案。
repos.summary_en: Arboris-Novel is an AI-powered writing assistant for creators, featuring character management, outline generation, and intelligent content continuation. It supports multi-version comparison and personalized style adaptation to create a smart writing companion that remembers your world and understands characters, with Docker-based deployment.

repos.description: Deploy your private Gemini application for free with one click, supporting Gemini 1.5, Gemini 2.0 models.
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Next Chat 是一个开源的 Gemini AI 聊天框架，支持一键免费部署私有应用，兼容 Gemini 1.5/2.0 系列模型。基于 Next.js + Tailwind CSS 构建，提供 Web、桌面多端支持，具备函数调用扩展能力，适用于企业级私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Next Chat is an open-source, extensible chatbot framework for Gemini AI models (1.5/2.0). Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, it enables one-click free deployment of private web applications across Web, MacOS, Windows, and Linux platforms with function calling support.

repos.description: MemFree - Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator
repos.summary_zh: MemFree 是一款混合 AI 搜索引擎与 AI 页面生成器，支持多模态输入（文本/图片/文件）、多 AI 模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini）及多搜索引擎，可快速检索知识库与全网信息并生成生产级 UI 页面，显著提升效率并降低成本。
repos.summary_en: MemFree is a Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator that supports multimodal inputs (text/images/files), integrates multiple AI models (Claude/GPT/Gemini) and search engines, enabling fast retrieval from knowledge bases and the web, plus instant generation of production-ready UI pages to boost efficiency and reduce costs.

repos.description: 🚀 一键部署个人的 ChatGPT 镜像站
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT Mirror 是一个个人 ChatGPT 镜像站，支持多账号共享管理，提供与官网一致的完整功能体验。通过录入 ChatGPT Token 实现团队协作访问，内置 API 接口（/v1/chat/completions）兼容主流客户端，无需翻墙即可使用。支持 Docker 一键部署，含管理后台和临时聊天模式，现已停止维护并推荐迁移至 Grok Mirror。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT Mirror is a personal ChatGPT mirror site enabling multi-account sharing and management for team collaboration. It delivers full-featured access identical to the official site, with built-in API (/v1/chat/completions) compatible with clients like ChatGPT-Next-Web. No VPN required; supports Docker one-click deployment, admin panel, and ephemeral chat modes. Discontinued; users advised to migrate to Grok Mirror.

repos.description: Agent-native AI assistant — chat, write, whiteboard, learning, all in one.
repos.summary_zh: YOLO 是一款专为 Obsidian 设计的智能 AI 助手插件，支持 Agent 模式、多窗口对话和知识库问答。通过工具调用与自定义技能实现自动化操作，结合 RAG 技术将整个知识库作为上下文，提供多语言、多模型支持的流畅写作与任务处理体验。
repos.summary_en: YOLO is an intelligent, multilingual AI assistant plugin for Obsidian, featuring Agent mode with tool calling and custom skills, multi-window chat, RAG-powered knowledge base Q&A, and seamless integration with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and other mainstream LLMs.

repos.description: A more beautiful and easier-to-use alternative to OpenClaw. It features a nicer Web UI, built-in IM support, a sandboxed runtime and channel-based team collaboration. Under the hood, it is powered by a Claude Code–based agent.
repos.summary_zh: Poco 是一款基于 Claude Code 的智能体平台，提供比 OpenClaw 更美观易用的替代方案。核心特性包括安全沙箱环境、多模态文件支持、原生 Claude Code 交互体验（计划模式/提问模式）、内置浏览器与 GitHub 集成、MCP/Skills 扩展能力，以及钉钉/飞书/Telegram 消息集成。采用 Next.js + FastAPI 架构，支持 Docker 一键部署和移动端访问。
repos.summary_en: Poco is a safer and more user-friendly alternative to OpenClaw, powered by a Claude Code-based agent. It features a secure sandboxed runtime, native Claude Code experience (Plan Mode, AskQuestion), built-in browser, GitHub integration, MCP/Skills extensibility, IM integrations (DingTalk/Feishu/Telegram), and multilingual support. Built with Next.js + FastAPI, deployable via Docker with mobile access.

repos.description: Desktop Agent for Any Task
repos.summary_zh: WorkAny 是一款桌面 AI 智能体应用，通过自然语言指令执行复杂任务，支持实时代码生成、工具调用和沙箱环境运行。基于 Claude Agent SDK 构建，集成 MCP 协议与多模型供应商，提供文件管理、文档/网页/表格/幻灯片生成等全场景能力，适用于自动化办公与软件开发。
repos.summary_en: WorkAny is a desktop AI agent that executes tasks via natural language, featuring real-time code generation, sandboxed execution, and workspace management. Built on Claude Agent SDK with MCP support and multi-provider LLM integration, it enables automated file organization, document/web/table/slide generation, and software development workflows.

repos.description: ❤️‍🔥 A chrome extension as an alternative to Notion AI that goes beyond Notion AI. | 一个替代 Notion AI 的浏览器插件，不止于 Notion AI
repos.summary_zh: Writely 是一款基于 OpenAI GPT 模型的浏览器插件，旨在替代 Notion AI。它支持在任意网页编辑器中提供智能写作辅助、邮件撰写、文章创作及社交媒体互动等功能，显著提升用户的内容创作效率与质量，实现跨平台的智能文本处理体验。
repos.summary_en: Writely is a browser extension powered by OpenAI's GPT model, designed as an alternative to Notion AI. It enables intelligent writing assistance across any webpage editor, supporting email composition, article drafting, and social media interactions, thereby enhancing content creation efficiency and quality with cross-platform accessibility.

repos.description: Awesome AI GPTs, OpenAI GPTs, GPT-4, ChatGPT, GPTs, Prompts, plugins, Prompts leaking
repos.summary_zh: Awesome AI GPTs 是一个精选的 OpenAI GPTs 资源库，涵盖提示词工程、内容创作、编程辅助、数据分析等场景。项目提供热门 GPTs 推荐、插件安装指南、知识库构建工具及安全防护方案，助力用户高效利用 AI 能力。
repos.summary_en: Awesome AI GPTs is a curated collection of OpenAI GPTs resources, covering prompt engineering, content creation, coding assistance, and data analysis. It offers hot GPTs recommendations, plugin installation guides, knowledge base tools, and security solutions to enhance AI utilization.

repos.summary_zh: 即梦3.0逆向API服务，提供零配置部署的图像生成能力，支持多路token并发，兼容OpenAI接口标准，每日免费66次生成额度，适用于个人测试与学习用途。
repos.summary_en: Jimeng AI Free API service enables zero-configuration deployment of image generation via reverse-engineered API, supporting multiple tokens and OpenAI-compatible interface, offering 66 daily free generations for testing purposes.

repos.description: 可商业化的 AI Web 平台，提供一站式人工智能服务解决方案。支持私有化部署，内置多用户管理，适合企业、团队或个人快速构建 AI 服务。
repos.summary_zh: 99AI 是一个可商业化的 AI Web 平台，提供一站式人工智能服务解决方案。支持私有化部署与多用户管理，集成 AI 对话、深度思考、联网搜索、智能图表生成及自定义应用广场等功能，适用于企业、团队或个人快速构建商业化 AI 服务。
repos.summary_en: 99AI is a commercializable AI web platform offering an all-in-one AI service solution. It supports private deployment, multi-user management, and integrates features like AI chat, deep thinking models, web search, intelligent diagram generation, and customizable agent apps for rapid enterprise or team AI service development.

repos.description: 完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App | Completely free, open-source, collaborative accounting Web App
repos.summary_zh: Cent 是一款完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App，基于 GitHub 仓库实现数据同步与版本控制，无需服务器即可跨平台实时协作。支持语音记账、AI 智能分析、多币种管理、地图可视化、周期记账等高级功能，采用纯前端 PWA 架构，数据完全自持于用户私有仓库，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Cent is a completely free, open-source collaborative accounting web app that uses GitHub repositories for data synchronization and version control, enabling real-time cross-platform collaboration without servers. It supports advanced features like voice记账, AI analysis, multi-currency management, map visualization, and recurring transactions. Built as a pure frontend PWA with data stored in user-owned private repositories for full privacy and security.

repos.description: Lumina Note - A modern Markdown note-taking app with live preview, bidirectional links, and AI assistant
repos.summary_zh: Lumina Note 是一款本地优先的 AI 笔记应用，支持 Markdown 实时预览、双向链接（WikiLinks）和知识图谱可视化。集成多模态 AI 助手（Chat/Agent/Deep Research/Codex），提供本地语义检索（RAG）功能，确保数据完全掌控于用户手中。
repos.summary_en: Lumina Note is a local-first AI note-taking app featuring live Markdown preview, bidirectional links, and knowledge graph visualization. It integrates multimodal AI assistants (Chat/Agent/Deep Research/Codex) with local RAG retrieval, ensuring full data ownership and privacy.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款导航站建站工具，支持快速创建和管理网站目录，内置自动爬虫抓取站点信息（基于 Playwright、Jina、OpenAI），提供用户管理、国际化、SEO 优化及多平台图片存储（MinIO、AWS S3、腾讯云 COS）。用户可一键部署个性化导航网站，适合内容聚合与分类管理场景。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is a navigation site builder that enables rapid creation and management of website directories with built-in auto-crawling (using Playwright, Jina, OpenAI), user management (Clerk), internationalization, SEO, and multi-cloud image storage (MinIO, AWS S3, Tencent COS). It allows instant deployment of customizable navigation sites for content aggregation and categorization.

repos.description: A Telegram bot with a silky smooth AI experience. UI enabled.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个功能强大的 Telegram AI 聊天机器人，支持 Azure OpenAI 和原生 OpenAI API，提供实时流式响应与 DALL·E 3 图像生成。具备多角色预设、用户分级权限、一键清空对话、容器化部署等特性，界面支持中英文切换，用户体验流畅顺滑。
repos.summary_en: A high-performance Telegram bot delivering seamless AI interactions via OpenAI and Azure OpenAI APIs, featuring real-time streaming responses, DALL·E 3 image generation, customizable bot personas, user tiered access control, and containerized deployment with bilingual UI support.

repos.description: OpenAI 接口聚合管理，我们致力于提供优质的API接入服务，让您可以轻松集成先进的AI模型至您的产品和服务。
repos.summary_zh: Chat API 是基于 One API 和 New API 二次开发的 OpenAI 接口聚合管理系统，提供多模型接入、令牌分组计费、渠道标签化管理及 WxPusher 推送通知等功能，支持 Docker/宝塔一键部署，适用于企业级 AI 服务集成。
repos.summary_en: Chat API is a secondary development of One API and New API, serving as an OpenAI interface aggregation management system. It offers multi-model access, token-based billing, channel tagging, WxPusher notifications, and supports Docker/Baota one-click deployment for enterprise-level AI service integration.

repos.description: 微信4.x数据解密并生成年度总结，高仿微信，支持实时更新，导出聊天记录，朋友圈等大量便捷功能
repos.summary_zh: 微信4.x数据解密与分析工具，支持聊天记录、朋友圈解密与可视化，提供高仿微信界面的年度总结生成、实时更新、搜索及导出功能，涵盖联系人管理与多消息类型展示。
repos.summary_en: WeChat 4.x data decryption and analysis tool with chat history, Moments decryption, annual summary generation, real-time updates, search, export, and contact management features, featuring a WeChat-like interface.

repos.description: 微信聊天记录导出、分析工具
repos.summary_zh: Wechat Explorer 是一款专为 iOS 设备设计的微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，通过解析 iTunes 备份中的微信数据，支持导出聊天室记录、统计好友标签及聊天室活跃度，并可生成 HTML 报告转为 PDF，适用于个人数据备份与社交行为分析。
repos.summary_en: Wechat Explorer is an iOS-focused tool for exporting and analyzing WeChat chat records by parsing iTunes backups. It supports exporting chatroom logs, generating friend label statistics, and creating PDF reports from HTML exports, ideal for personal data archiving and social behavior insights.

repos.description: 🚀 MiniMax大模型海螺AI逆向API【特长：超自然语音】，支持MiniMax Text-01、MiniMax-VL-01模型，支持高速流式输出、语音合成、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为MiniMax海螺AI提供逆向API服务，支持MiniMax-Text-01和MiniMax-VL-01模型，具备高速流式输出、语音合成与识别、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析及多轮对话能力。零配置部署，支持多路token并发，自动清理会话痕迹，接口兼容ChatGPT，适用于测试与个人使用。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for MiniMax Hailuo AI, supporting MiniMax-Text-01 and MiniMax-VL-01 models. It features high-speed streaming output, speech synthesis/ASR, web search, document analysis, image parsing, and multi-turn conversations. Zero-configuration deployment, multi-token concurrency, session auto-cleanup, and full ChatGPT compatibility. For testing only; commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: The first browser AI Agent extension to support Agent Skills, enabling AI to perform complex tasks through an expandable skill system. 🌟 Star if you like it! | 首个支持 Agent Skills 的浏览器 AI Agent 扩展，让 AI 通过可扩展技能系统执行复杂任务 🌟 如果喜欢请点个 Star！
repos.summary_zh: Tactus 是首个支持 Agent Skills 规范的浏览器 AI Agent 扩展，通过可扩展技能系统让 AI 执行复杂任务。支持多模型对话、网页内容理解、图像识别及 HTTP MCP 外部工具集成，具备脚本安全执行与信任机制，实现高效自动化操作。
repos.summary_en: Tactus is the first browser AI Agent extension implementing the Agent Skills specification, enabling complex task execution via an extensible skill system. It supports multi-model conversations, page understanding, vision capabilities, and HTTP MCP integration, with secure script execution and user trust controls for efficient automation.

repos.description: Local-first multi-AI group chat desktop app — pull gpt, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek into one conversation. Tauri 2 + React 19.
repos.summary_zh: Talkio 是一款本地优先的多 AI 群聊桌面应用，支持将 GPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek 等模型整合进同一对话。基于 Tauri 2 + React 19 构建，具备身份角色系统、MCP 工具调用、文件解析、流式输出等功能，提供跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux/Android）体验，所有数据加密存储于本地 SQLite，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Talkio is a local-first multi-AI group chat desktop app that integrates models like GPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek into one conversation. Built with Tauri 2 + React 19, it features persona-based roleplay, MCP tool integration, file parsing, streaming output, and cross-platform support (Windows/macOS/Linux/Android), with all data encrypted locally in SQLite for privacy.

repos.description: 一个先进的聊天应用，演示了一种独特的对话范式：用户的查询首先由两个不同的人工智能角色进行辩论和提炼，然后才提供最终的综合答案。该项目利用 Google Gemini API 驱动一个逻辑型 AI (Cognito) 和一个怀疑型 AI (Muse)，它们协作生成更健壮、准确和经过严格审查的响应。
repos.summary_zh: Dual AI Chat 是一个基于 React 19 的先进聊天应用，创新性地引入双 AI 协作范式：逻辑型 Cognito 与创意型 Muse 通过内部辩论提炼答案，结合 Google Gemini 深度思考模型，提供更高准确性、全面性和严谨性的综合响应。
repos.summary_en: Dual AI Chat is an advanced chat application built with React 19 that introduces a novel dual-AI collaboration paradigm. It leverages two distinct AI personas—Cognito (logical) and Muse (creative)—to debate and refine responses, enhanced by Google Gemini's deep thinking capabilities for more accurate, comprehensive, and rigorously vetted answers.

repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into DingTalk without requiring a VPN. Ideal for enterprise customer service and office automation, it significantly lowers the barrier to AI adoption.

repos.description: 🧠 Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code as an AI writing companion — smart context, undo, diff preview, multi-thread chat.

repos.summary_en: ChatFree is a desktop AI assistant built with Python, offering multi-model support and intelligent text completion. It enables global AI interaction via system proxy detection and hotkeys, freeing users from browser constraints for enhanced writing and conversation.

repos.description: VPS上的AI聚合脚本
repos.summary_zh: VPSAI 是一个开源的 AI 服务快速部署工具，专为 VPS 环境设计。它通过一键脚本自动化部署多种流行 AI 服务（如 OneAPI、Open-WebUI 等），支持 Docker/Nginx 环境配置、HTTPS 自动证书申请及数据持久化备份。具备服务监控与更新功能，适用于快速搭建私有化 AI 服务集群。
repos.summary_en: VPSAI is an open-source tool for rapid deployment of AI services on VPS. It automates the setup of popular AI platforms (e.g., OneAPI, Open-WebUI) via one-click scripts, supporting Docker/Nginx configuration, HTTPS with Let's Encrypt, data persistence, and backup. Features service monitoring and updates, ideal for private AI infrastructure deployment.
